## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Madrid, Spain. It starts at C. de San Nicolás, 15.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Travel to the highlands of Spain and visit two picture-perfect towns full of monuments from Roman and medieval times. They’ll beguile you and offer a glimpse into the soul of Old Castile.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €61.02. It was rated 5.0 out of 5 from 13 ratings and 5 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
